reviews.text: Genuinely really good and I haven’t even started working with him yet. He gave me tips and tricks to use with my pup and by 2 days my dog is progressing more than ever! Will definitely be working with Andrejus in the future

Andrejus is an absolute dog whisperer and fully understands my Frenchie. Really friendly, knowledgeable and patient, with a genuine understanding of dogs and their behaviour. The advice and guidance have been really helpful, and you can tell they genuinely care about getting the best results for both the dog and the owner.

I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for professional, friendly and effective dog training. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Amazing trainer
Really knows how to train dogs well and quickly

Fantastic academy and an incredible team of professionals! We brought our dog here for training and couldn't be happier with the experience. Their approach is clear, structured, and easy to follow for both the dog and the owner. We noticed a huge improvement in behavior in a very short time. Thank you so much for your hard work 100% recommended to any dog owner!

Highly reckless behavior from the owner. Bringing two large, high-drive Belgian Malinois into a tight, enclosed indoor area completely off-leash just to film a social media stunt is a massive public safety hazard. A busy cafe is not a live training ring, and it is entirely irresponsible to risk the safety of people for internet clout.

Came here with my 1yr old Shepard with terrible dog reactiveness after about 2-3 sessions was calm around dogs in close proximity, was able to put him in a heel properly and take him anywhere, great trainer would definitely use him again

Really good trainer. Very clear, friendly and direct.He explained all the concepts we need to work on very well. We can’t wait for the next training session .
Thank You

Andreius was fantastic with us from the start, giving both me and my dog total confidence that we could achieve what we wanted. His clear instructions, patience and confidence have seen us make progress quickly and return to really enjoy training again. I would highly recommend Andreius and Miracle K9 Academy.

Really pleased with the training session. He helped me massively with getting my dog to walk properly on a loose lead, and the difference was noticeable straight away. He explained everything clearly and showed me exactly what I needed to do so I can keep working on it at home.

Really knowledgeable, patient and easy to work with. Would definitely recommend to anyone who wants to improve their dog’s training and behaviour.

we searched for a good trusted trainer for our dog, he's a American bulldog cross staffy, our dog was very mistreated before we rescued him at 12 weeks and has had trouble excepting anyone other than myself, wife and my 3 boys who has imprinted on heavily! we had a dog who, would lunge anyone who walked past my children or my wife and weighing 31kg is not a good thing ! andrejus from the moment we met him, had us drawn in by his professionalism! his knowledge for k9 is unreal ! our dog duke lunged at andrejus on first meet, where most trainers would of declined our dog duke, but andrejus focus was immense and was not scared by it ! instead took the challenge on ! our dog was not only well looked after for 2 weeks but like a different dog ! I am now more. Confident when walking duke he has better focus and no longer lunges at peolpe or other dogs if you need your dog training this is the man and will continue to use him for 1 to1 thank you, your a legend
